config.probe_timing_allocation: For terminal stage r, pass the nested stage prefix and alpha=.05*prefix_stage_count/3/family_heads. Thus every interval retains the full three-stage Bonferroni allocation, including shorter timed runs.
config.target: Supplied physical low-minus-high write sources and shared h only; output before current write, no model/codec/trace reconstruction. B3 independent-write K plus exactly the same signed2c; B4 coherent Kdiag plus2c.
config.mask_scope: Per-fixture/per-head top8 is an objective diagnostic, not a TRAIN-aggregated calibration mask or deployed policy.
config.timing: Fresh process per method; identical fixture and SciPy/NumPy imports; one untimed warmup then3 full-API timings. Includes repeated input checks and exactc within probe API, excludes process startup/load/serialization. All samples retained; no extrapolated end-to-end calibration claim.
config.memory: Linux process peak RSS after load and after measured work, high-water increase, input bytes, and API-declared core workspace; core workspace excludes allocations/transients/imports and is not peak memory.
config.confidence_scope: One predeclared probe seed on this fixed real trajectory; observed interval inclusion is a check, not empirical coverage-rate evidence. Conditional Gaussian intervals across supplied128rows and3stages; no FP64 rounding-error proof and no across-run95% claim unless family_heads was predeclared accordingly.
config.no_selection: No speed-based promotion without exact mask/certificate; no method/seed/chunk/tolerance tuning or repeated-seed coverage experiment.
config.failure_policy: First mismatch/nonfinite/timeout is retained and ends this frozen run; no silent retry or substitute numbers.
config.codec_scope: LEGACY_P_PRE CPU-generated TRAIN associative-recall0/layer0/head0; FP32 codec/anchor with FP64 physical subtraction and response. Not the upcoming selected codec.
